sent: Your question and a few excerpts from related notes are sent to {{provider}} to answer it.
sentHybrid: Your question is also sent to {{provider}} to search by meaning.

screen.title: Ask your notes
screen.intro: The AI assistant answers briefly from the notes in the folders AI may read, and links back to the notes it used.
screen.modeHybrid: Search by keywords and by meaning.

panel.title: Ask
panel.intro: Ask about this note and related notes.
panel.outOfScope: This note is outside the folders AI may read, so the assistant only uses other notes.

input.label: Your question
input.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
input.tooLong: The question is too long: {{max}} characters at most.

notices.citation-rejected: Some citations didn't match any note, so they were removed.
notices.uncited: This answer doesn't cite any note yet. Please check it.
notices.out-of-scope-hidden: Some items are in folders AI may not read, so they aren't shown.

notReady.disabled: AI is off. You can turn it on in Settings, under AI.
notReady.reconsent: You just changed the AI provider. Open Settings, under AI, and press Review and agree.
notReady.noKey: To ask right here in the app, AI needs an API key from Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI or Google Gemini, entered in Settings, under AI.
notReady.routeA: Use your Claude account through Claude Desktop: see Connect Claude in Settings.
notReady.budget: This month's limit is used up ({{limit}} tokens). Raise the limit in Settings or wait for next month.

errors.network: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.auth: The API key is wrong or has expired. Check it in Settings.
errors.rateLimit: {{provider}} is getting too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.quota: Your {{provider}} account has run out of quota or credit. Check your account on the {{provider}} site, then try again.
errors.timeout: {{provider}} took too long to answer, so the app stopped waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.server: {{provider}} is having problems. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.badRequest: {{provider}} didn't accept this request. Check the model name in Settings, then try again.
errors.malformed: The answer from {{provider}} was cut off. Try again.
errors.provider: {{provider}} couldn't answer. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.overBudget: This question needs more tokens than are left of this month's limit. Raise the limit in Settings or wait for next month.
errors.appOffline: Couldn't reach the app's server. Check that Second Brain is running, then try again.
errors.incomplete: The answer was cut off. Try again.
errors.unavailable: AI isn't ready for this vault yet. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: The AI assistant couldn't answer. Try again.

save.title: Save the answer as a note
save.body: The question and the answer are saved as a new note that says the answer came from the AI assistant.
save.failed: Couldn't save the answer. Try again.
